title: 隧道湧水排導系統
summary: 本課以用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水為主線，從地下水與施工用水收支與支管流速與有效斷面建立系統邊界，再把集水容量與反應時間、堵塞敏感度與維護連到長期水文與維護交接。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy. It begins with Groundwater and process-water balance and Branch velocity and effective area, links Sump storage and response time and Blockage sensitivity and maintenance, and ends with Long-term hydrology and handover. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查地下水與施工用水收支：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage；再獨立檢查支管流速與有效斷面：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。總排水保持 80 L/s，施工用水由 25 增為 35 L/s，推估地層湧水由 55 降為 45 L/s；總量不變可能掩蓋來源改變。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 將比對濾層粒徑、濁度、排水量與附近沉陷趨勢作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Groundwater and process-water balance: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Independently check Branch velocity and effective area: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. At a constant total discharge of 80 L/s, process water rising from 25 to 35 L/s reduces inferred groundwater inflow from 55 to 45 L/s; unchanged totals can conceal changing sources. The two results are not a complete design because drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Use compare filter grading, turbidity, discharge and nearby settlement trends as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水與施工用水收支」與「支管流速與有效斷面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水與施工用水收支」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater and process-water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。泵站啟停造成出水脈動，應在相同時間窗比較流入與流出；若水槽水位改變，還須加入庫容項才可辨認真正湧水趨勢。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水與施工用水收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. Pump cycling makes outlet flow intermittent, requiring equal accounting windows. Include changing sump volume to identify the underlying groundwater trend instead of confusing operational pulses with geology. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater and process-water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地下水與施工用水收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地下水與施工用水收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Groundwater and process-water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地下水與施工用水收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater and process-water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地下水與施工用水收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater and process-water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gravity pipe and gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力排水依靠水面或能量坡降，管底設計坡度不一定等於實際水力坡降。接頭錯台與局部反坡會形成積泥，端點高程正確也可能漏掉中段低窪；Manning 模型只在定義清楚的均勻流條件下提供基準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積；若出現中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力管線與坡度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity drainage follows a water-surface or energy gradient, which need not equal the designed invert grade. Steps and reverse slopes trap sediment despite correct endpoints. Manning's equation gives a baseline only under a clearly defined uniform-flow condition, not arbitrary backwater or pressurized flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs n=0.013 s/m^(1/3), A=0.07069 m2, R=0.075 m, S=0.005; Q=(1/n)*A*R^(2/3)*S^0.5=(1/0.013)*0.07069*0.075^(2/3)*0.005^0.5=0.0684 m3/s。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 重力管線與坡度：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gravity pipe and gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 泵站揚程與耗能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pump head and power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泵站揚程與耗能」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump head and power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵站需要克服靜揚程、沿程損失及局部損失，額定流量只對應特定工作點。效率隨工況改變，不能將馬達功率直接等同水力輸出；並聯泵也不一定讓流量倍增，因為系統曲線會隨流量上升。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點；若出現沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泵站揚程與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumps overcome static lift, friction and local losses, with rated flow tied to a duty point. Efficiency changes with operation, so motor power is not hydraulic output. Parallel pumps need not double discharge because the system curve rises with total flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point. If growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pump head and power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, Q=0.055 m3/s, H=20 m, eta=0.70; P=rho*g*Q*H/eta=1000*9.81*0.055*20/0.70=15416 W=15.4 kW。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 泵站揚程與耗能：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump head and power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. steps.instruction: 集水槽提供短暫流量緩衝，實際可用容量要扣除沉積、最低運轉水位與不可用空間。以總幾何容積除湧水量會高估反應時間，泵停機後流入也可能變化；需使用可用容量和明確情境，而非把時間當成工作許可。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄；若出現沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水容量與反應時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 長期水文與維護交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term hydrology and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期水文與維護交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term hydrology and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析；若出現把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道排水變化可以完全不參考周邊水文資料」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tunnel discharge changes can be interpreted without surrounding hydrological data" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
